issues.description: The template code calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) but the provided template ArrayHelpers.java defines the method as appendElement(...). The solution repository uses addElementToArray(...). This naming mismatch between ArrayHelpers and its usages in Stock.java will cause compilation failures for students using the template and is inconsistent with the solution's API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent across the template and usage. Either rename the method in src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...), or change calls in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java to use appendElement(...). Prefer matching the solution name addElementToArray(...) so the helper matches Stock and the reference implementation.
